mechanism_narrative: A higher federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) compresses equity discount rates and signals restrictive monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days without threshold conditions.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or FEDFUNDS level shows no significant negative correlation with 20d forward returns (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month rise in housing starts (HOUST) above 0.5% monthly growth signals strengthening economic activity, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: HOUST growth exceeds 0.5% in 3 months but 20d forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 0.2 percentage points and fall in industrial production (INDPRO) below 0.5% over 3 months signals economic contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE rises > 0.2pp and INDPRO falls > 0.5% in 3 months
failure_condition: Joint condition (UNRATE rise > 0.2pp and INDPRO fall > 0.5% in 3 months) is met but 20d forward returns are negative in less than 40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A monetary tightening cycle defined by FEDFUNDS rise above 0.25 percentage points and CPIAUCSL index above 310 signals active inflation control, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS rises > 0.25pp in 3 months and CPIAUCSL > 310
failure_condition: Monetary tightening cycle condition is met but 20d forward returns are negative in less than 40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate (UNRATE) falling below 3.5% signals a tight labor market, which is associated with strong economic growth and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE falls below 3.5% but 20d forward returns are positive in less than 40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: Positive year-over-year growth in real GDP (GDPC1) signals economic expansion, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: GDPC1 year-over-year growth is positive but 60d forward returns are positive in less than 40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production (INDPRO) falling below 100 (2017 base) signals manufacturing contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO falls below 100 but 20d forward returns are negative in less than 40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: CPIAUCSL index above 320 signals persistent high inflation, which is associated with aggressive monetary policy tightening and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL exceeds 320 but 20d forward returns are negative in less than 40% of instances.
